risk_surfaces.reason: Specific brand and variant candidates must be resolved before generic catalog candidates.
Structured brand identity must survive without duplication in the final visible item.
A governed external result remains usable only when current brand, variant and serving evidence match.
Webhook redelivery for one message id must not duplicate the selected nutritional item.
Persistence, totals and the later WhatsApp response must consume the same resolved reference.
